items.title: Your Annotation is Good Enough for R&D, but not for the FDA.
items.summary: Medical AI annotation pipelines often work well for research but fail under FDA scrutiny. Regulators expect documented multi-expert consensus, transparent disagreement resolution, and full annotation provenance. Workflows that rely on single annotators or simple tiebreakers may produce accurate labels but lack the auditability required for regulatory clearance and clinical deployment.

items.title: The Ultimate Guide to Your New Everything Tote
items.summary: Some bags are cute. Some bags are practical. And then there’s the newly redesigned Hathaway Tote Bag which is both, without making a big deal about it. The Hathaway Tote and Small Hathaway Tote were designed for the days when you need your bag to keep up with your calendar, your wardrobe, and your “I might need this later” instincts. The soft premium quilted cotton is fully reversible (yes, really) with thoughtfully placed pockets, polished enough to make even a messy day look intentional. If you’ve been looking for a large tote bag that feels elevated but lives in the real world, meet your new favorite Vera Bradley tote bag and her smaller, equally capable sister. What Makes the Hathaway Different from Every Other Tote in My Closet? Let’s start with the obvious: it’s reversible! Yes. Fully. Reversible. One tote. Two looks. No drama. You get the beauty of our signature pattern play and the freedom to flip the mood whenever you want. Bright and expressive one day. Understated and polished, the next. Your muse doesn’t live in neutral. Neither should your bag. And because this is a Vera Bradley tote bag, the inside is just as well-made as the outside, with a quilted cotton lining, intentional structure, and plenty of pockets that don’t disappear into the abyss. Is The Hathaway Truly a Large Tote Bag? Absolutely! The sizing is very generous for anyone who needs the extra space. Hathaway Tote Bag Dimensions: • 14.0" w x 13.0" h x 6.5" d • 20.5" top width • 12.0" handle drop That 20.5" top width gives you plenty of room, so your laptop, planner, water bottle, cardigan, cosmetic case, and the book you swear you’ll finish can coexist peacefully. This is the large tote bag you reach for when your day has layers. What Fits Inside the Hathaway Tote Bag? Short answer: more than you think. Long answer: • Up to a 15" Laptop • A Full-Size Notebook or Planner • Organizer Pouches • Large Wallet • Glasses Case • A 20 oz. water bottle • Light Sweater or Scarf • Snacks (because obviously) • Small Tech Accessories And thanks to the interior slip pocket, your phone or keys won’t migrate to the bottom. Is This Tote Bag Structured or Slouchy? It’s that perfect in-between: Structured enough to stand tall, yet relaxed enough that it’s easy to carry even when full. The quilted cotton lining adds softness and stability, while the hidden magnetic closure helps keep everything secure without the need for fussing with zippers. What Makes The Hathaway a Great Vera Bradley Commuter Tote Bag? A true Vera Bradley commuter tote bag needs: ✔ Room for your laptop ✔ Comfortable shoulder drop ✔ Easy-access pockets ✔ Secure closure ✔ Style that works from coffee shop to conference room to gym The Hathaway checks every box. The 12" handle drop fits comfortably over your shoulder, even with a blazer or coat. The hidden magnetic closure keeps everything in place while staying easy to open during the rush between train/subway/bus stops or meetings. And because it’s reversible, it adapts to your workweek wardrobe without requiring backup. What is the Difference Between This and The Small Hathaway Tote Bag (Besides the Size)? The Small Hathaway is the perfect Vera Bradley tote bag when you don’t need to bring everything with you, just your essentials. Small Hathaway Tote Bag Dimensions: • 11.25" w x 13.0" h x 5.0" d • 18.0" top width • 12.0" handle drop Compact, not cramped. What Fits Inside The Small Hathaway Tote Bag? The Small Hathaway Tote Big is perfect for your everyday essentials: • Tablet or Slim Laptop • Small Wallet • Phone • Small Cosmetic Pouch • Sunglasses • Mini Notebook • Protein Bar • Lip Balm It’s ideal for lighter commute days, weekend outings, gallery hopping, or when you want something compact but still impactful. Best of all, it features the same reversible design, hidden magnetic closure, and cotton lining as her big sister. What are the Pocket Details for both Totes? Both the Hathaway and Small Hathaway Tote Bags feature: • Exterior slip pockets • Interior slip pockets The exterior pockets give you quick access to your phone or keys. Their interior pockets keep the essentials securely in place. Both bags are designed to keep up with your pace. How Do I Style These Tote Bags? Both of the Hathaway tote bags are highly adaptable to any look you choose. Pair either bag with • Denim and Sneakers • Tailored Trousers and a Silk Blouse • A Summer Dress and Sandals This isn’t a bag that completes your look. It collaborates with it. Is This My New Everyday Vera Bradley Tote Bag? The answer is yes if you need: • A true large Vera Bradley tote bag that handles real life. • A flexible commuter companion. • A reversible silhouette that doubles your styling options. • A bag that respects both craft and practicality. And if you lean toward lighter days and tighter edits? The Small Hathaway Tote Bag is waiting for you. Two Sides. All You! Some people believe you need a different bag for every version of yourself. We don’t. You contain multitudes. Your tote can, too. The Hathaway Tote Bag isn’t here to tell you who to be. It’s here to keep up with you and your needs. SHOP THE HATHAWAY TOTE BAG
